title: Change in bachelor's degree attainment, ages 25-34, since 1995 (points)

source.name: U.S. women are outpacing men in college completion
source.publisher: Pew Research Center (analysis of Census Bureau data)

notes: Illustrative -- real published Pew Research/Census figures formatted for narration. Share of 25-34 year-olds with a bachelor's degree rose from 25% to 47% for women (a 22-point gain) and from 25% to 37% for men (a 12-point gain) between 1995 and 2024.
